notes: goal-target MSE: v3_validate scoring on designs with the RAPM rows / weights / covariates and a goals target (EV: attacking side; PP: PP side), players fixed at the as-of v4 ratings plus the impact term
penalty deltas are sums over player-windows (Poisson deviance or squared error of the net), SE clustered by player

"v4" penalty model = v4-unit rates (t0 400) scaled per position group to the PP-unit level: it predicts the taken side and the net differential at least as well as the PP-unit rates (tuning net z 2.3, holdout z 2.8) - reported, the units choice was declared definitional
